title: TeamLead
description: A Team Lead assignment (PRD 8.3, 10.1, 16.2): the person (user) who acts as Team Lead id, and the one expert domain the owner assigned them. The shape of each entry of config/teams.yaml and of a Team Lead set in the Team Lead console. authz.ref of a Team Lead's answer is id. A Team Lead opens a gate only when the gate names this domain and the owner's policy it names lists the domain in team_lead_domains, and only when the world's owner made this assignment before the answer (outbox OB-01). Removing a Team Lead deletes the record, so a removed Team Lead answers nothing.

assignment.description: Who assigned the domain and when: only the owner assigns domains (PRD 16.2).
